title: EmailSubmission/queryChanges ignores filter
description: Found in JMAP-skk9.15. crate-jmap-mail-server/src/submission.rs handle_submission_query_changes never reads the filter argument (it now decodes sort). RFC 8620 §5.6: 'filter: The filter argument that was used with Foo/query.' Decode it with filter_arg as handle_mailbox_query_changes does and pass QueryChangesParams::filter, so a malformed filter is invalidArguments/unsupportedFilter.
notes: Duplicate of JMAP-mk7s (filed in error during JMAP-skk9.15). The sort half of JMAP-mk7s is done by JMAP-skk9.15; only the filter half remains.
